description.en: Plugin index for DSH Personal Agent, a macOS personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 个人助理插件的索引：DeepSeek Harness 上的 macOS 个人助理。

description.en: A personal assistant for macOS: Apple Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Mail (drafts only, never sends), tasks kept in sync with Reminders and Mail, rescheduling, a 今日 sticky note, a weekly journal and six personalities.
description.zh: macOS 个人助理：接入 Apple 日历、提醒事项、备忘录和邮件（只存草稿、从不发送），任务与提醒事项和邮件保持同步，支持改期，还有今日便签、每周日记和六种性格。
